source: 693 Golden Corpse
target: 693 Aureum Cadaver

source: Lumian looked at the gold mask in his hand, white and black paint covering the eyes and face.
target: Lumian aspexit larvam auream in manu sua, quae oculos et faciem albo atque nigro pigmento tegebat.

source: Without hesitation, he put it on.
target: Sine mora, eam induit.

source: A cold sensation quickly seeped into his skin, and the weight of the gold felt unusually real.
target: Sensatio frigida celeriter in cutem eius diffusa est, et pondus auri inusitate reale videbatur.

source: His mind spun as he gazed through the mask at the entrance of the black ancient tomb and the end of the still river, which had mostly receded.
target: Mens eius vertiebatur dum per larvam ad introitum sepulcri antiqui nigri atque ad finem fluminis quieti, qui paene recederat, intuebatur.

source: This time, he finally saw a slightly indistinct figure.
target: Hoc tempore, tandem vidit figuram paulum indistinctam.

source: The figure wore a strange rusted iron crown and a dark robe with peculiar patterns.
target: Figura gerebat coronam ferri rubiginosi insoliti et pallium atrum cum figuris peculiariis.

source: Its skin was milky-white, and its eyes were so dark they seemed to hold the entire night.
target: Cutis eius erat lactea, et oculi tam obscuri ut totam noctem continerent.

source: A pale-white beard fluttered around its mouth and chin.
target: Barba alba pallida circa os et mentum oscillabat.

source: The old man sat cross-legged, hands tucked into his sleeves.
target: Senex in cruribus sessus erat, manus in manicae inclusae.

source: He leaned against the open door of the black ancient tomb, his expression cold and impassive, like a statue.
target: Se inclinavit ad ianuam apertam sepulcri antiqui nigri, vultu frigido et imperturbabili, instar statuae.

source: As Lumian looked over, the old man met his gaze.
target: Dum Lumian aspexit, senex oculos eius obviam tenuit.

source: His dark eyes seemed to reflect Lumian, as if numerous phantoms had appeared.
target: Oculi obscuri eius videbantur Lumianum reflectere, tamquam multa phantasmata apparuisset.

source: B0x𝔫oѵ𝑒𝙡.com
target: B0x𝔫oѵ𝑒𝙡.com

source: Splash!
target: Splash!

source: Behind the old man, an even more illusory, nearly lightless water wave rippled in the void.
target: Post senex, fluctus aquae adhuc magis illusorius, paene lucis carens, in vacuo ondulavit.

source: The colossal figure in blood-stained armor roared angrily, attempting to approach.
target: Figura colossalis in armatura sanguine maculata irate fremuit, appropinquare conans.

source: Lumian’s right palm instantly burned.
target: Palma dextra Lumiani statim arsit.

source: The old man in the rusted iron crown and strange robe withdrew his hands from his sleeves.
target: Senex, in corona ferri rubiginosi et pallio insolito indutus, manus ex manica retraxit.

source: His hands had pale, dark skin that was still smooth.
target: Manus eius habebant cutem pallidam atque obscuram, sed lenem.

source: The backs were cracked, each crack either covered in white feathers stained with pale yellow oil or dripping with decaying yellow pus.
target: Dorsae erant fissae; singula fissura vel operta erat alis albis, pallide oleo luteo tinctis, vel stillabat pus flavo putrescente.

source: Upon seeing this, Lumian’s thoughts vanished, and he felt as if he were descending into endless cold darkness.
target: Videns haec, cogitationes Lumiani evanuerunt, atque sensit se in infinitas frigidas tenebras descendere.

source: A familiar burning sensation emanated from his left chest.
target: Sensatio ardens nota emanabat ex pecto sinistro eius.

source: Combined with the burning, frenzied, violent sensation in his right palm, it awakened Lumian’s consciousness, allowing him to find a lifeline in the darkness.
target: Cum sensu ardente, furioso, et violento in palma dextro coniuncto, conscientiam Lumiani excitavit, permittens ei viam salutis in tenebris invenire.

source: Using this opportunity, Lumian regained the ability to think.
target: Hac occasione utens, Lumian facultatem cogitandi recuperavit.

source: He saw nearly black blood vessels protruding from the dark eyes that seemed to hide the entire night.
target: Vidit vasa sanguinea paene nigra ex oculis obscuris eminentia, quae totam noctem celare videbantur.

source: They were tainted with madness that threatened to bury and end everything.
target: Ea vasa insanitate tincta erant, quae minabantur omnia sepelire et finem imponere.

source: The eyes closed, and the illusory ripples and colossal figure behind the old man vanished.
target: Oculi claudebantur, et undae illusoriae atque figura colossalis post senex evanuerunt.

source: Lumian’s vision began to clear, and his perception of the outside world fully returned.
target: Visio Lumiani coepit clarificari, et perceptio eius de mundo exterio plene rediit.

source: A sharp pain coursed through him.
target: Dolor acutus eum pervasit.

source: Lumian glanced down at his right hand and realized disgusting bumps bulged from his wrist to the back of his hand.
target: Lumian dextram manum intuebatur et animadvertit ab carpo usque ad dorsum eius tumores horrendos eminere.

source: His hair seemed to have thickened and turned whiter.
target: Capilli eius densiores et albi facti videbantur.

source: He flipped his palm over and saw that the mark left by Blood Emperor Alista Tudor’s remnant aura had completely surfaced.
target: Palmam suam vertit et vidit signum, quod aura residua Imperatoris Sanguinis Alista Tudor relicta erat, omnino emersum esse.

source: It was a vivid red.
target: Erat ruber vividus.

source: Surrounding these marks was decaying flesh, seeping pus, and pale-white skin.
target: Circa haec signa erant caro putrescens, pus exsudans, et cutis pallide alba.

source: Lumian frowned.
target: Lumian frontem contraxit.

source: Despite the Blood Emperor’s remnant aura being fully activated, Amandina, Lugano, and the others around him didn’t show any signs of panic or fear.
target: Etsi aura residua Imperatoris Sanguinis prorsus activa erat, Amandina, Lugano, et ceteri circa eum nullas signa panici aut timoris ostenderunt.

source: He didn’t sense any extremely frenzied or violent thoughts either!
target: Neque sensit ullam cogitationem nimis furibundam aut violentam.

source: Wait…
target: Exspecta…

source: The figure in the blood-stained armor seems to be Blood Emperor Alista Tudor…
target: Figura in armatura sanguine maculata videtur esse Imperator Sanguinis Alista Tudor…

source: This place feels similar to the Samaritan Women’s Spring…
target: Hic locus videtur similis esse Fons Mulierum Samaritarum…

source: Could the figure sitting at the tomb’s entrance be the Underworld Daoist mentioned by the Armored Shadow?
target: Num figura, sedens ad introitum sepulcri, sit ille Daoista Inferorum, quem Umbrā Armata commemoratum est?

source: Why are he and the Blood Emperor appearing here again?
target: Cur ille et Imperator Sanguinis iterum hic apparent?

source: Shouldn’t they be at the source of the Samaritan Women’s Spring?
target: Nonne illi ad fontem Mulierum Samaritarum esse debent?

source: Are the two connected?
target: Num inter se conexae sint?

source: Did the Underworld Daoist discover the Blood Emperor’s residual aura on me and conveniently seal it?
target: Num Daoista Inferorum invenit auram residuam Imperatoris Sanguinis in me et eam commodē obsignavit?

source: Even if I fully activate it, I won’t be able to unleash the crazy Red Priest’s aura?
target: Etiamsi eam plene activavero, non potero efferre auram sacerdotis Rubri insani.

source: Uh, I don’t know if it’s because of Mr. Fool’s seal or because I’m wearing Hisoka’s golden mask, but the Underworld Daoist didn’t directly allow me to undergo immortal ascension, nor did he force me to lose control…
target: Heu, nescio utrum propter sigillum Domini Stulti aut quia larvam auream Hisoka geram, sed Daoista Inferorum mihi ascensionem immortalem directe subire non permisit, nec me coegerit ut imperium perderem.

source: Lumian quickly grasped his predicament.
target: Lumian celeriter suam condicionem intellexit.

source: As the immortalized Devil entered the black ancient tomb, the situation inside changed once more.
target: Cum Diabolus immortalizatus in sepulcrum antiquum nigrum intravit, res intus iterum mutatae sunt.

source: The tomb, which had fallen silent, emitted a rustling sound, accompanied by the clang of metal colliding with stone.
target: Sepulcrum, quod in silentium ceciderat, edidit sonum susurrantem, cum clangore metalli in lapidem collidens.

source: The next instant, a golden figure materialized beside the Underworld Daoist at the tomb’s entrance.
target: Subsequenti momento, figura aurea iuxta Daoistam Inferorum ad introitum sepulcri apparuit.

source: The figure was covered in gold, with long limbs and a golden mask streaked with white and black paint.
target: Figura erat auro operta, membris longis et larva aurea albo et nigro picta.

source: It belonged to the same type as the one on Lumian’s face and the pale-white goat’s head!
target: Pertinebat ad eundem genus, ac ea quae in facie Lumiani et in capite cabrae pallide albae apparuerat!

source: The golden-masked figure stiffened, as if its limbs were dead.
target: Figura larva aurea induta riguit, quasi membra eius mortua essent.

source: Relying solely on the strength of its waist, it sat up from lying flat like a corpse.
target: Solum innixus robore lumbi, ex recumbentia ut cadaver surrexit.

source: Eyes closed, it turned its head towards the pale-white goat closest to it.
target: Oculis clausis, caput suum converterit ad cabram pallide albam prope illam.

source: The pale-white goat’s aura instantly turned ordinary, making it unable to walk on the still river.
target: Aura cabrae pallide albæ statim ordinaria facta est, ita ut illa in flumine quieto ambulare non posset.

source: It rapidly decayed, sank, and quickly vanished.
target: Celeriter putrescens, delapsa, et cito evanuit.

source: The golden figure, eyes still closed, turned its head to the tattered, sinister cloth doll.
target: Figura aurea, oculis adhuc clausis, caput suum converterit ad pupam pannosam et sinistram.

source: The eerie vines on the cloth doll’s Gothic dress suddenly came alive, coiling around the doll, rendering it powerless and immobile.
target: Vinea inspissatae in veste Gothica pupae pannosae repente animatae sunt, circum pupam involutae, eam impotentem et immobilis reddentes.

source: The corpse’s head turned to the slowly walking green-eyed man.
target: Caput cadaveris convertit ad virum oculis viridibus, qui lente ambulabat.

source: The green-eyed man, his eyes reflecting the ugly puppet, suddenly halted.
target: Vir oculis viridibus, quibus pupam foedam speculabatur, subito sistit.

source: With a bang, his body transformed into a bloody piglet.
target: Cum strepitu, corpus eius in porcellum sanguinolentum mutatum est.

source: The ugly puppet landed beside the piglet, motionless, as if it had turned into the most ordinary and common puppet.
target: Pupa foeda iuxta porcellum appulit, immota, quasi in puppam vulgariam et communem versa esset.

source: Ludwig’s eyes lit up as he jogged over.
target: Oculi Ludovigi fulserunt, dum advenit currendo.

source: He leaped up like a massive frog and pounced on the bloody piglet.
target: Saltavit ut rana ingens et in porcellum sanguinolentum insiluit.

source: He grabbed its head and bit down.
target: Caput eius arripuit et mordere coepit.

source: Amandina closed her eyes in shock.
target: Amandina oculos clausit, stupefacta.

source: Louis Berry’s godson turned out to be such a monster?
target: Filiolus sponsi Ludovici Berry tam monstrum esse apparuit?

source: The pig wailed fiercely.
target: Porcellus vehementer ululavit.

source: The golden-masked corpse closed its eyes, turned its head, and faced Iveljsta Eggers.
target: Cadaver, larva aurea induta, oculos clausit, caput converterit, et Iveljsta Eggers opposuit.

source: Lumian’s forehead throbbed.
target: Frons Lumiani pulsabat.

source: He wanted to break through the sudden paralyzing pressure and teleport over to rescue Iveljsta, but he hesitated.
target: Voluit vim subitam, quae paralysabat, effringere et se translocare ut Iveljsta servaret, sed dubitavit.

source: Previously, he had restricted himself from approaching the black ancient tomb.
target: Primum se prohibuerat ne ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum appropinquaret.

source: At most, he would take a glance or two.
target: Maxime, semel aut bis solum intuebatur.

source: Now, he didn’t want to break this self-imposed “rule.” Violating it meant immense risk.
target: Nunc hanc sibi ipsi impositam regulam violare nollebat; violatio autem magnum periculum significabat.

source: However, Iveljsta was from the Church of The Fool.
target: Attamen Iveljsta ex Ecclesia Stulti erat.

source: Just as Lumian made his decision, the golden corpse turned its head again, but Iveljsta remained unchanged.
target: Simul ac Lumian consilium cepit, aureum cadaver iterum caput convertere coepit, sed Iveljsta immutatus mansit.

source: He was still severely injured, his aura weak.
target: Adhuc graviter laesus erat, et aura eius debilis.

source: What’s going on? Why did the cold corpse in the ancient tomb spare Iveljsta?
target: Quid agitur? Cur cadaver gelidum in sepulcro antiquo Iveljsta parcit?

source: The Underworld Daoist didn’t do anything to him when he looked at him…
target: Daoista Inferorum nihil ei fecit, cum eum intuebatur…

source: Lumian was puzzled as the corpse’s golden mask faced Reaza.
target: Lumian perplexus erat, cum larva aurea cadaveris versus Reaza versa esset.

source: After the pale-white goat vanished, Reaza summoned an undead creature to envelop him and blinked to the edge of the ancient tomb area.
target: Postquam cabra pallide alba evanuit, Reaza creaturam ex mortuis evocavit, ut eum circumamplexaret, et celeriter ad limitem areae sepulcri antiqui transiit.

source: He was about to escape into the forest, but before he could do anything else, his body froze.
target: Paratus erat in silvas effugere, sed antequam quidquam aliud ageret, corpus eius congelatum est.

source: Pop, pop, pop.
target: Pop, pop, pop.

source: Huge, wet warts erupted from Reaza’s face, neck, and the backs of his hands, accompanied by disgusting mucus.
target: Ingens, umidae verrucae de facie, colo, et dorso manuum Reazae eruperunt, comitatae ab immundo moco.

source: The vice-captain of Port Pylos’s patrol collapsed, rapidly disintegrating into countless bloody warts that squirmed in the gaps of his thin suit.
target: Vice-captain Portus Pylos vigilum collapsus est, celeriter disintegratus in innumerabiles verrucas sanguineas, quae in fissuris tenuis vestis eius se contorquebant.

source: The undead creature summoned by Reaza transformed into thin human skin and gently landed.
target: Creatura ex mortuis a Reaza evocata in cutem humanam tenuem transformata est et leniter ad terram descendit.

source: Lumian’s scalp tingled as he watched.
target: Scalpum Lumiani formicarum sensu palpitabat dum spectabat.

source: Finally, he broke free from the paralysis caused by the corpse sitting up.
target: Denique a paralysi, quam cadaver surrectus attulit, evasit.

source: He said to Lugano, Amandina, and the others, “Grab hold of me!”
target: Dixit ad Lugano, Amandinam, et ceteros: “Prehendite me!”

source: He was about to teleport back to Tizamo!
target: Paratus erat se translocare ad Tizamo!

source: At that moment, the corpse’s golden-masked face turned towards him.
target: Ad hoc momentum, facies cadaveris, larva aurea induta, versus eum convertit.

source: Lumian’s body turned cold.
target: Corpus Lumiani frigide factum est.

source: Ignoring Camus and company, he immediately activated the black mark on his right shoulder.
target: Neglexit Camus et ceteros, et statim signum nigrum in umero dextro suo activavit.

source: Suddenly, he saw the cold corpse’s face, its eyes peeking out from under the golden mask with white and black paint, open.
target: Subito, vidit faciem cadaveris frigidi, oculos eius, sub larva aurea cum albo et nigro pigmento, eminentes et apertos.

source: It was a pair of cold, icy-blue eyes.
target: Erat par oculorum frigidorum, glacialiter caeruleorum.

source: Icy-blue eyes? Lumian was taken aback, finding them familiar.
target: Oculi glaciales caerulei? Lumian obstupefactus erat, eos notos inveniens.

source: These are…
target: Hi sunt…

source: These are Naboredisley’s eyes!
target: Hi sunt oculi Naboredisley!

source: Dammit, why is Naboredisley here? Why is he a cold corpse in the black ancient tomb?
target: Eheu, cur Naboredisley hic est? Cur is cadaver gelidum in sepulcro antiquo nigro est?

source: What right does He have to bestow the Beyonder powers of the Prisoner pathway?
target: Quod ius habet ille ut largiatur potentates Beyonder viae Captivi?

source: It can’t be real. It’s not Naboredisley, but its eyes resemble…
target: Non potest esse verum. Non est Naboredisley, sed oculi eius similes sunt…

source: Amidst Lumian’s thoughts, he saw a smile in the icy-blue eyes, a smile of playfulness, understanding, and certainty.
target: Inter cogitationes Lumiani, vidit risum in oculis glaciales caeruleis, risum ludicrum, intellegentiae atque certitudinis.

source: This was a stark contrast to the pained expressions in the icy-blue eyes on Hanth Island.
target: Hoc erat acutum contrarium vultuum dolentium in oculis glaciales caeruleis in Insula Hanth.

source: Suddenly, a half-withered, violently beating dark-red heart soared from the golden corpse’s hand and flew out of the completely disintegrated still river.
target: Subito, cor dimidium exsiccatus, vehementer pulsans, rubri obscuri, ex manu cadaveris aurei surrexit et e flumine quieto omnino disintegrato evanuit.

source: A short figure pounced on the heart like a frog and grabbed it.
target: Figura brevis ut rana in cor insiluit et eum arripuit.

source: It was Ludwig, his mouth filled with blood.
target: Erat Ludwig, cuius os sanguine repletum erat.

source: The smile in the golden corpse’s icy-blue eyes grew more relaxed.
target: Risus in oculis glaciales caeruleis cadaveris aurei paulatim lenior factus est.

source: He nodded at Lumian and willingly fell back to His original position.
target: Annuit ad Lumian et libenter ad suam originariam positionem recidit.

source: He had no intention of seizing the opportunity to leave the black ancient tomb.
target: Noluit occasionem capere ut sepulcrum antiquum nigrum relinqueret.

source: With a splash of illusory water, the tomb’s open door gradually closed.
target: Cum aqua illusoria spumante, ianua aperta sepulcri paulatim clausa est.

source: Seated by the door, the figure suspected to be the Underworld Daoist vanished.
target: Sedens iuxta ianuam, figura, quae ut Daoista Inferorum suspicata erat, evanuit.

source: Wh— Naboredisley’s corpse doesn’t seem willing to leave the tomb…
target: Heu— Cadaver Naboredisley non videtur sepulcrum relinquare velle…

source: How did He end up lying in there?
target: Quomodo in eo iaceret?

source: Lumian couldn’t figure out the reason, so he looked at Ludwig and realized the boy was holding a half-withered dark-red heart to his mouth.
target: Lumian causam non intellexit, ergo ad Ludovicum aspexit et animadvertit puerum cor dimidium exsiccatum rubri obscuri ad os tenere.

source: Lumian wanted to stop him but lacked the ability.
target: Lumian eum sistere vellebat, sed facultatem non habebat.

source: The surrounding corpses didn’t seem to attract Ludwig as much as the half-withered heart.
target: Cadavera circumstantia Ludwig non tam alliciebant quam cor dimidium exsiccatum.

source: Clang!
target: Clang!

source: The tomb door slammed shut, causing the entire area to tremble.
target: Ianua sepulcri subito clauserunt, totam aream tremere facientes.

source: Lumian and the others witnessed dream fragments one after another, and their surroundings blurred.
target: Lumian et ceteri fragmenta somniorum uno post alium conspecta sunt, et circumiecta eorum obscura erant.

source: After a brief daze, Lumian realized he was lying in the middle of an unlit street.
target: Post brevem stupefactum, Lumian intellexit se in medio viae non illuminatae iacere.

source: The crimson moon was bright in the sky, casting its light.
target: Luna coccinea in caelo praeclara lucebat, sua luce effundens.

source: This was inside Tizamo.
target: Hoc erat intra Tizamo.
